messages:
maria: quick idea 11 can we add a tiny on-node "evict capture" that snapshots the inputs to eviction decisions (scores, metric windows, observed residency) so we can replay churny cases offline? current logs don't let us reproduce ordering.
aj: yes. keep it light-weight. three capture modes: off, meta, and full. meta = tenant_h, prefix, owner, epoch, score_delta, reason. full = meta + metric_vector + residency_snapshot + tie_seq. default meta.
lee: perf: prefer ring buffer per-worker flushed async. full-mode must be opt-in via canary flag. for hosted we never emit reversible tenant ids; use HMAC with per-deploy salt (KMS).
sam: replay harness should accept zipped jsonl shards and a scorer_version. it should be able to re-run scoring deterministically using the logged tie_seq so ordering matches. CLI: `evict-playback --input s3://... --scorer v2 --mode step`.
hari: also capture a tiny topology snapshot (node list + shard assignments at capture time) so replay doesn't assume different ownership. store as a small header record per shard-file.
maria: good point. also record eviction-trigger-type (deadline, score, prefill) so we can filter.
aj: implementation notes: keep per-minute shard files, gzipped, indexed by prefix hash range. add metrics: trace_events_dropped and trace_write_latency.
lee: test plan: perf test that writes 50k meta events/sec and measure p99 CPU and memory. include backlog bounding so we never OOM.
sam: for parity tests, we'll generate synthetic logs and assert playback actions equal original decisions with same scorer binary. include a compatibility shim to load older scoring weights.
audit-bot: policy note: tenant_h must be HMAC-sha256 with KMS-managed salt for hosted. private deployments can toggle.
maria: ops: gate full-mode behind feature-flag and anomaly triggers e.g. eviction-churn>8% for 5m. capture-on-demand via admin dump is useful too.
hari: edge-case: cache compaction may remove fields used for replay. ensure residency_snapshot is a compacted snapshot (keys + residency token + epoch) so replay can reconstruct.
aj: open Q: should we also capture prefill request ids so we can relate prefill->evict cycles? i'd say yes for full-mode.
lee: I'll prototype buffer+async-writer, aj prototype schema+indexing, sam build playback CLI, hari add topology snapshot, maria will track runbook and canary plan.
audit-bot: ticket created EDG-999 evict-capture-playback-prototype, assignees aj,lee,sam,hari.
maria: target a minimal PoC (meta capture + playback verifying ordering) in 2w. thumbs up? :thumbsup:
